sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:56

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:56:1
items.html: The name YH that is in Keter is simple and not in a filling: Namely at the time when the ZON of Keter refined from phase three in them, and the coupling ceased from there, and the levels of the ZON departed to their root, and only the records of the ZON remained in the vessel of Keter. They are then discerned as a simple name YH, lacking the filling in them — that is, the measure of coarseness that draws the measure of their level and fills them with their light.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:56:2
items.html: With Yods, with Heys and with Alephs. The coarseness of phase three, which draws the level of Hochma, is called a filling with Yods. And the coarseness of phase two, which draws the level of Bina, is likewise called a filling with Yods, except for the Aleph that is in the Vav in it, like this: Yod-Vav-Dalet, Hey-Yod, Vav-Aleph-Vav, Hey-Yod. And the aspect of ZA is HaVaYaH in a filling with Alephs. And the aspect of Malchut is HaVaYaH in a filling with Heys.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:56:3
items.html:
The four lights are all included in the Nukva, who is the Hey of the name YH. That is, the vessel of the Nukva is the Hey of YH; for only the vessels are called letters, and not the lights themselves. And remember this, as above in the words of the ARI (Part 4, Chapter 3, item 12).
The filling of that Hey is with a Yod, like this: Hey-Yod — for the coarseness of phase three is called Yod, as above. And it was explained above in the Inner Light, page 324, the passage beginning “Mati,” that by reason of the ascent of the male of Hochma, who is of the coarseness of phase three, the Nukva of Keter is found to return and receive this coarseness of phase three into her screen, study it there well. And so the Hey, who is the Nukva of Keter, is found to be filled with a Yod.
